title.narrative: Catalyzing Long Term Finance through Capital Markets

description.narrative: The development objective of the Catalyzing Long Term Finance through Capital Markets Project for Serbia is to: (i) improve the enabling environment for capital markets development; and (ii) deepen the corporate bond market, including through green and other thematic issuances. The project comprises of two components. The first component, institutional, legal, and regulatory reforms will focus on supporting the government in strengthening the institutional, legal, and regulatory framework for capital markets development. It consists of following sub-components: (i) Ministry of Finance (MoF) - capital markets policy and regulatory unit; (ii) strengthening the Serbian securities commission (SSC) and the central securities depository (CSD); (iii) strengthening of Belgrade stock exchange (BELEX); (iv) taxation reform; (v) other technical assistance for implementing the capital markets development strategy. The second component, corporate bond issuer program (CBIP) will focus on expanding the corporate bond issuer base.

The project's overall objective is to (i) improve the enabling environment for capital markets development and (ii) deepen the corporate bond market, including through green and other thematic issuances.

title.narrative: Number of green and other thematic corporate bond issuances

comment.narrative: The PDO Indicator will measure the number of green and other thematic corporate bonds issued under the Corporate Bond Issuer Program.

title.narrative: Number of corporate bond issuances by first-time issuers

comment.narrative: This PDO indicator will measure the number of corporate bonds issued by first time issuers between 2023-2028 with the support of the Corporate Bond Issuer Program.

title.narrative: Compliance achieved in the focus areas identified by the assessment of implementation of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulation

comment.narrative: Focus areas of improvement will be identified in the IOSCO Assessment of recommendations. Compliance means at minimum 75 percent of the focus areas have been addressed and are considered either fully or broadly implemented based on the international standards.

title.narrative: Number of corporates that received financial education/were informed about alternatives to bank financing

comment.narrative: The intermediate indicator will measure the increasing awareness of Serbian corporates regarding the benefits of alternative corporate debt financing, beyond bank financing.

title.narrative: Share of Corporate Bond Program beneficiaries satisfied with the Corporate Bond Program support via periodic surveys

comment.narrative: The intermediate indicator will measure the share of Corporate Bond Program beneficiaries satisfied with the Corporate Bond Program support via periodic surveys. It is intended to measure beneficiary satisfaction and effectiveness of the engagement processes ando capture the WB corporate commitment of citizen engagement.

title.narrative: Volume of corporate bonds issued by majority women-owned firms

comment.narrative: This intermediate indicator will capture the number of corporate bonds issued by majority women-owned firms, defined as firms with at least 51 percent corporate ownership by women. The volume is in RSD.

title.narrative: Total number of corporate bond issuances, including total number of green and other thematic bonds

comment.narrative: The total number of corporate bond issuances, including total number of green and other thematic bonds will be captured. This number will count each time a bond is issued within the CBIP.

title.narrative: Number of companies participating in the Corporate Bond Issuer Program, including the number of women managers participating in the Corporate Bond Issuer Program

comment.narrative: The indicator will count the total number of companies admitted to and participating in the Corporate Bond Issuer Program, including the number of women managers participating in the Corporate Bond Issuer Program.

title.narrative: Total volume of corporate bond issuances, including volume of green and other thematic bonds

comment.narrative: The intermediate indicator will capture the total volume of corporate bonds issued, including green/thematic bonds. The volume is in USD.

title.narrative: Simplified tax framework in place for capital market development

comment.narrative: In November 2022, the Ministry of Finance completed a capital market taxation framework analysis. Subsequent to the tax analysis the aim is to have simplified tax framework in place for capital market development.

title.narrative: Time-bound action plan adopted for resolving the issue of dormant accounts

comment.narrative: The intermediate indicator will monitor whether a time-bound action plan that addresses the issue of dormant accounts has been adopted.

title.narrative: One-stop shop established with interactive web portal

comment.narrative: This intermediate indicator will monitor whether the one-stop shop has been created by the GoS authorities.
